import os
import time
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Device Setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Load Data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Check sample submission format
sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Preprocess Texts
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_labels = train_df[target_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
print(f"Y labels shape: {y_labels.shape}")

texts = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
test_texts = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")

# Split Training Data - Proper hold-out validation (85/15 split)
np.random.seed(42)
torch.manual_seed(42)
torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(42)
indices = np.arange(len(texts))
n_train = int(0.85 * len(texts))
train_indices, val_indices = np.split(indices, [n_train])

print(f"Train samples: {len(train_indices)}, Val samples: {len(val_indices)}")

# Create word-level TF-IDF features
print("Fitting word-level TF-IDF on training data...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, max_df=0.85, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_word = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts[train_indices])
X_val_word = vectorizer.transform(texts[val_indices])
X_test_word = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

# Add unigram-only TF-IDF features for better capture of specific toxic words
print("Creating unigram-only TF-IDF features...")
unigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 1),
    max_features=3000,
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_unigram = unigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(texts[train_indices])
X_val_unigram = unigram_vectorizer.transform(texts[val_indices])
X_test_unigram = unigram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

# Add character-level bigram features
print("Creating character-level bigram TF-IDF features...")
char_bigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(2, 2),
    max_features=2000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.85,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_char_bigram = char_bigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(texts[train_indices])
X_val_char_bigram = char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(texts[val_indices])
X_test_char_bigram = char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

# Combine features using horizontal stack
print("Combining feature matrices with hstack...")
X_train_word = X_train_word.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_val_word = X_val_word.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_test_word = X_test_word.toarray().astype(np.float32)

X_train_unigram = X_train_unigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_val_unigram = X_val_unigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_test_unigram = X_test_unigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)

X_train_char_bigram = X_train_char_bigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_val_char_bigram = X_val_char_bigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)
X_test_char_bigram = X_test_char_bigram.toarray().astype(np.float32)

# Use hstack instead of + to combine feature matrices
X_train_char = np.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_unigram, X_train_char_bigram])
X_val_char = np.hstack([X_val_word, X_val_unigram, X_val_char_bigram])
X_test_char = np.hstack([X_test_word, X_test_unigram, X_test_char_bigram])

print(
    f"Combined features shape: train={X_train_char.shape}, val={X_val_char.shape}, test={X_test_char.shape}"
)

# Calculate class weights for imbalanced data
pos_weights = np.ones(6)
for i in range(6):
    neg_count = np.sum(y_labels[train_indices, i] == 0)
    pos_count = np.sum(y_labels[train_indices, i] == 1)
    if pos_count > 0:
        pos_weights[i] = np.sqrt(neg_count / pos_count)
    print(
        f"  Target {target_cols[i]}: neg={neg_count}, pos={pos_count}, weight={pos_weights[i]:.4f}"
    )

print(f"Class weights: {pos_weights}")

# Convert pos_weights to tensor for use in loss function
pos_weight_tensor = torch.tensor(pos_weights).to(device)


# Improved Model architecture with larger hidden layers
class ToxicModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_classes=6, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super(ToxicModel, self).__init__()
        # Increased capacity: 512 -> 256 instead of 256 -> 128
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, 512)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(512)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(512, 256)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(256, num_classes)

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = F.relu(self.bn2(self.fc2(x)))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.fc3(x)
        return x


def train_and_evaluate(
    model_cls,
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_val,
    y_val,
    X_test,
    seed,
    dropout_rate,
    max_epochs=8,
    device=device,
    batch_size=256,
    gradient_accumulation_steps=4,
):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    X_train_tensor = torch.from_numpy(X_train).float().to(device)
    X_val_tensor = torch.from_numpy(X_val).float().to(device)
    X_test_tensor = torch.from_numpy(X_test).float().to(device)
    y_train_tensor = torch.from_numpy(y_train).float().to(device)
    y_val_tensor = torch.from_numpy(y_val).float().to(device)

    num_classes = 6
    model = model_cls(
        X_train_tensor.shape[1],
        num_classes=num_classes,
        dropout_rate=dropout_rate,
    ).to(device)

    loss_fn = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight_tensor)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.002, weight_decay=0.01)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=max_epochs, eta_min=0.0001
    )

    train_dataset = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(X_train_tensor, y_train_tensor)
    train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0
    )

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    patience = 3
    no_improve = 0

    print(
        f"\nTraining (dropout={dropout_rate}, grad_acc={gradient_accumulation_steps})..."
    )

    best_model_state = None

    # Effective batch size = batch_size * gradient_accumulation_steps
    effective_batch_size = batch_size * gradient_accumulation_steps
    print(f"  Effective batch size: {effective_batch_size}")

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        epoch_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0

        for X_batch, y_batch in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(X_batch)
            loss = loss_fn(logits, y_batch)

            # Gradient accumulation
            loss = loss / gradient_accumulation_steps
            loss.backward()

            num_batches += 1
            if num_batches % gradient_accumulation_steps == 0:
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
                optimizer.zero_grad()

            epoch_loss += loss.item()

        avg_loss = epoch_loss / len(train_loader)

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_logits = model(X_val_tensor)
            test_logits = model(X_test_tensor)
            val_probs = torch.sigmoid(val_logits).cpu().numpy()
            test_probs = torch.sigmoid(test_logits).cpu().numpy()

            val_loss = loss_fn(val_logits, y_val_tensor)

            if val_loss.item() < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss.item()
                no_improve = 0
                best_model_state = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
            else:
                no_improve += 1

        if (epoch + 1) % 2 == 0:
            print(
                f"  Epoch {epoch+1}, Train Loss: {avg_loss:.4f}, Val Loss: {val_loss.item():.4f}"
            )

        scheduler.step()

        if no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    if best_model_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)

    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        final_test_logits = model(X_test_tensor)
        final_test_probs = torch.sigmoid(final_test_logits).cpu().numpy()

        final_val_logits = model(X_val_tensor)
        final_val_probs = torch.sigmoid(final_val_logits).cpu().numpy()

    return final_test_probs, final_val_probs, model


# Train ensemble of 3 models with different hyperparameters for diversity
print("\n=== Training Ensemble Models ===\n")

test_probs_list = []
val_probs_list = []
weights = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
models = []

hyperparams = [
    (42, "Model1", 0.3),
    (123, "Model2", 0.4),
    (456, "Model3", 0.35),
]

for seed, name, dropout_rate in hyperparams:
    test_probs, val_probs, model = train_and_evaluate(
        ToxicModel,
        X_train_char,
        y_labels[train_indices],
        X_val_char,
        y_labels[val_indices],
        X_test_char,
        seed,
        dropout_rate,
        max_epochs=8,
        batch_size=256,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=4,
    )
    test_probs_list.append(test_probs)
    val_probs_list.append(val_probs)
    models.append(model)
    print(f"\n{name} predictions shape: test={test_probs.shape}, val={val_probs.shape}")
    gc.collect()
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# Average ensemble predictions
final_test_pred = np.average(np.array(test_probs_list), axis=0, weights=weights)
final_val_pred = np.average(np.array(val_probs_list), axis=0, weights=weights)
print(
    f"Ensemble predictions shape: test={final_test_pred.shape}, val={final_val_pred.shape}"
)

# Evaluate on Validation Set (proper hold-out evaluation)
print("\n=== Validating Ensemble on Hold-out Set ===")
val_y = y_labels[val_indices]

val_auc_list = []
for i in range(6):
    try:
        auc = roc_auc_score(val_y[:, i], final_val_pred[:, i])
        val_auc_list.append(auc)
        print(f"AUC - {target_cols[i]}: {auc:.4f}")
    except ValueError:
        val_auc_list.append(0.5)

val_metric = np.mean(val_auc_list)
print(f"Ensemble Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {val_metric:.4f}")

# Save final submission on TEST data
print("\n=== Saving Submission ===")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": final_test_pred[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": final_test_pred[:, 1],
        "obscene": final_test_pred[:, 2],
        "threat": final_test_pred[:, 3],
        "insult": final_test_pred[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": final_test_pred[:, 5],
    }
)

print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission_df.columns.tolist()}")
submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")

print(f"\nFinal Ensemble Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {val_metric:.4f}")
print("Done!")

This architectural change will be applied consistently across all three ensemble models while keeping the same TF-IDV features, ensemble strategy, and training pipeline to maintain a single atomic improvement that can be clearly measured on the validation set.
